title: Refunds
intro: Full refund obligations and recorded outcomes. Only super administrators may issue or reconcile refunds.
refreshFirst: Close this dialog and refresh the list before another action; the previous outcome is uncertain.
issueHint: Issue a full refund of {amount}? This sends a financial request and cannot be undone here.
reconcileHint: Check the recorded refund of {amount} against provider evidence. This does not resend a refund request.
updated: Refund record updated. Check its recorded status.
reviewRequired: Verified payment evidence is required. Review this refund before proceeding.
unavailable: Payment verification is unavailable. Refresh later before trying another action.
readFailedHint: Refresh to load current refund records.
emptyHint: Refund obligations appear when a paid booking cannot be fulfilled or its trip is cancelled.
